name: select
useFor: Use for one choice among a known list of up to about fifteen (a state, a voltage, a sort). Put a Label above it with aria-labelledby. Pass `name` to submit the value with its form (FormData). Use size sm in dense toolbars. For long or searchable lists use Combobox; for two to five short options use Radio Group or Toggle Group. A long list fades at an edge (fade-y) where more options scroll past it.
constraints: A check mark or circle for the chosen row (it is the diamond)
A select for a yes or no choice
source: Drawn from Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107) and the design's unit list

title: Select
description: Mireye's select: the field's frame (36px, Bone, 1px Stone line, the cut) with the value and the brand arrow's head turned down. Its list floats 4px under it in the same frame: 28px rows in 80% Forest, the highlighted one a Fog plate with the small cut, the chosen one full Forest with a solid diamond.
